memory: Matched anti‑alias (fc=10 kHz) + 96 kS/s ADC reduces contamination and preserves headroom. Phase coherence ≤0.4° to ~1950 Hz, then jumps near 1975–2000 Hz. Shaft modal at 1.18 kHz separable. Split‑LO fail above 1.6–1.8 kHz; routing raw photodiodes into single external demod improved coherence but left a sharp collapse at 2 kHz. Standing plan: keep electrostatic calibrations, pursue raw photodiode routing with matched AA and investigate timing/PLL/jitter as residual error sources.
